description: Check CanadaBuys now for newer versions of every data file and download those that changed, replacing the local cache. Searches already refresh on their own schedule (new tenders every 2 hours, open tenders and this year's awards every 6, the rest daily); call this only when the user asks for the latest data or a search reported a refresh warning. It also downloads the award files if no award search has been run yet, which can take a minute.
name: refresh_data
title: Refresh data from CanadaBuys
